meta.title: Rafi's 2-Year Software Engineering Roadmap
meta.fridayPolicy: No study tasks. Personal + family day.
principles: Every month ends with a tangible deliverable
meta.questionPolicy: Every DSA/problem-solving topic includes 5 Codeforces + 5 HackerRank + 5 LeetCode entries.

phases: Programming fundamentals, Dart, OOP, math and DSA foundations.
Flutter internals, networking, testing, performance and production architecture.
JavaScript/Node.js, Express, SQL, databases, Redis and backend architecture.
Kotlin, Android fundamentals, Compose, Coroutines, Room, Retrofit and Clean Architecture.
Networking, operating systems, advanced DSA and engineering fundamentals.
Dynamic programming, distributed systems and system design.
Cloud, Docker, Linux, security, observability and production engineering.
Interview readiness, projects, system design drills, DSA revision and applications.
